menu.title: 📱 OLX iPhone Scout I watch OLX for used iPhones and score every listing with AI. Pick an action:
start.greeting:
👋 Hi, {name}!

I monitor OLX for used iPhones (11–17), analyse each listing with AI — text, photos and seller reviews — and send you only what matches your filters.

Start by creating a filter.
help.text: How it works 1. Create a filter: model, storage, price range, city. 2. I check OLX every few minutes for new listings. 3. Every new listing is scored 1–10 by AI based on its text, photos and the seller's reviews. 4. You get a card with the score and a short verdict — open Details for the full breakdown. You can have several filters at once, pause them, or delete them in My filters. Scores are an AI opinion, not advice. Always inspect the device in person.
